title: Superhost Benefit: Conversion Fee Discount on Payout Methods
content:
Superhosts receive a discount on the conversion fee charged on transfers to their Payout Methods paid in a currency other than USD. The discount is read from the host's Host Accounts record: the account's tier and its "Superhost since" date, the date Superhost was awarded in the current run.

## The benefit

The conversion fee's Superhost discount is:

| Host account tier | "Superhost since" date | Superhost discount on the conversion fee |
|---|---|---|
| Superhost | At least 24 whole months before the settlement day | 25% |
| Superhost | Fewer than 24 whole months before the settlement day | 10% |
| Any other tier (Starter Host, Standard Host, Professional Host, Professional Host Plus, Enterprise Partner) | — | Nothing |

The settlement day is the day the conversion fee falls due: the rail's processing time in business days after the transfer was sent. The months are whole months counted from the "Superhost since" date to that day.

## Boundary of the 24-month line (hypothetical dates, settlement day 2026-05-12)

| "Superhost since" | Whole months to the settlement day | Discount |
|---|---|---|
| 2024-05-12 | 24 | 25% |
| 2024-05-13 | 23 | 10% |
| 2026-01-20 | 3 | 10% |

## Hypothetical illustration

An imagined Superhost awarded Superhost on 2023-11-02 receives a transfer to a PayPal method paid in EUR that settles on 2026-05-12. That is 30 whole months, so the conversion fee's Superhost discount is 25%. An imagined Professional Host with the same transfer receives no Superhost discount, being of another tier.

## Basis notes

- The discount is a percentage, decided as of the settlement day of the transfer the conversion fee belongs to.
- Only the tier on the host account decides it; a host whose tier is not Superhost on the record receives nothing under this benefit.
